```python
    # Overlap means interior points in common, so the effect of a corner exactly
    # on a side of the other is both edges excluded. The overlap region is determined
    # by clipping to narrower bounds along each axis.
    def rectangles_overlap(r1, r2):
        x_start = max(r1[0], r2[0])
        x_end = min(r1[2], r2[2])
        y_start = max(r1[1], r2[1])
        y_end = min(r1[3], r2[3])
        return x_start < x_end and y_start < y_end
```

```python
def rectangle_intersection_area(r1, r2):
    x_left = max(r1[0], r2[0])
    x_right = min(r1[2], r2[2])
    y_low = max(r1[1], r2[1])
    y_high = min(r1[3], r2[3])
    width = x_right - x_left
    height = y_high - y_low
    return width * height if width > 0 and height > 0 else 0
```
